hook: Easing DNA supercoiling strain by lowering TOP1 activity boosts how much MYC amplifies transcription.
hook_turn: boosts how much MYC amplifies transcription.
summary: The authors built a system that separates MYC's activation of specific genes from its general amplification of transcription. Cutting TOP1 activity by knockdown or low-dose inhibitor strengthened amplification, apparently because negative supercoiling aids promoter melting and polymerase loading. The evidence comes from cell and biochemical assays, not whole organisms.
title: Dynamic supercoiling sponsors transcription amplification by MYC.
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
